name: AspectRatioBox
description: A container that maintains a fixed aspect ratio regardless of its content. Useful for embedding media, images, or any content that must preserve a width-to-height relationship.

notes: AspectRatioBox is a layout utility with no inherent semantics.
Content inside the box should provide its own accessible roles and labels.

aspectRatio.description: The width-to-height ratio. For example, 16/9 for widescreen, 1 for square, 4/3 for classic.

children.description: Content rendered inside the aspect ratio container.

do: Use for embedding images or video that must maintain a fixed ratio.
Use aspectRatio={16/9} for widescreen media containers.
Use aspectRatio={1} for square thumbnails or avatars.
dont: Do not use for general-purpose containers that do not need a fixed ratio.
Do not nest AspectRatioBox inside another AspectRatioBox.
